meta_title: Gorilla Blackout - the hardcore student drinking game! | Challenges for two or more
meta_description: A fierce drinking game for students! Roll the die to reach the finish, but watch out for the Wheel of Rage, the waterfall and other surprises! Your goal is to reach the finish, but along the way you may face challenges, tasks, a waterfall tile and plenty of shots.
setup_logo_alt: Gorilla Blackout - the hardcore drinking game for students!
setup_intro_1: Welcome to Gorilla Blackout, an extremely firece drinking game made by two students! It's a board game played with dice, so naturally the goal is to reach the finish while completing tasks on the board, but that's easier said than done - and the more players join, the harder the game gets!
setup_intro_2: The game involves drinking plenty of both light and strong drinks, so we recommend players stock up generously. Good luck!
setup_previous_game_found: A previous game was found. Do you want to continue?
setup_rejoin_failed: Failed to join the multiplayer game
setup_footer_about: Gorilla Blackout is a completely free drinking game for students, always playable online at blackout.beer.

tile_challenge_text: {name} comes up with a challenge for you! If you don't do the challenge, drink 10 sips.

tile_waterfall_text: All players start drinking at the same time. Once you stop, the next player may stop, then the next one, and so on.

tile_kps_text: Play rock-paper-scissors with {name}. The loser takes a shot.
tile_rule: Make up a rule for the game! The rule stays in effect until someone makes up a new one. Breaking the rule costs five sips.
tile_dices35back: Roll two dice. If the sum is 11 or 12, move 35 tiles back!
tile_six_to_win: Roll the die. If you get a 6, you win the game!
tile_win_text: The other players can keep playing if they want.
wheel_drink_card_value: Drink as many as the card's value!
wheel_super_rule_text: Make up a super rule for the game! Unlike a normal rule, a super rule stays in effect for the whole game, and the penalty for breaking it is a shot.
